network_status.network: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti identificano il crollo del ponte ferroviario in località Cirone nel periodo di dissesto calabrese, senza pubblicare livello, portata o stazione sul Corace compatibile con la sezione. Nessun valore regionale viene trasferito al ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The sources identify failure of the Cirone railway bridge during the Calabria disruption period but publish no stage, discharge or Corace station compatible with the bridge section. No regional value is transferred to the bridge.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
